upstream.description: Parse files (e.g. code repos) and websites to clipboard or a file for ingestions by AI / LLMs

classification.analysis: Ingest is a Go CLI that walks a directory of source code (or crawls a website or PDF) and flattens it into a single markdown or JSON prompt suitable for feeding to an LLM, with include/exclude glob filtering, git diff/log inclusion, Tree-sitter-based code compression, offline or Anthropic-API token counting, and optional direct hand-off to any OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint. It targets developers who want to quickly build LLM context from a codebase or web page without manual copy-pasting, and ships as a single Go binary with shell completions. Actively maintained with recent commits and GitHub Actions release automation.

use_cases.title: Turn a code repo into a single LLM-ready markdown prompt
Crawl a website into markdown for LLM ingestion
Count and estimate tokens for a codebase before sending it to an LLM
Compress source files with Tree-sitter to save context tokens
